label: realestate.com.au Scraper
title: realestate.com.au Scraper: Buy, Rent & Sold Listings
metaDescription: Scrape realestate.com.au buy, rent and sold listings from any search or property URL: price, status, sold dates, features, inspections and agents.
intro: Paste a realestate.com.au search or property link (buy, rent or sold) and get price, status, sold dates, features, inspection times, agent and agency contacts and photos for every listing.
useCases: Pull sold results for a suburb

faq.a: Only for agencies publishing listings. This actor reads any public buy, rent or sold search link and returns every listing with price, features, inspection times and agency.

faq.q: Can I use it as a realestate.com.au API?
faq.a: Yes. Start a run from your own code with Apify's REST API (or the JavaScript and Python clients) and read the results as JSON; the run-sync endpoint returns the items in the same HTTP call. The same input also runs in the Apify Console, on a schedule, or from Make, Zapier and n8n.

officialApi: REA Group offers APIs to agencies for publishing their own listings, not for public listing data. This actor reads public realestate.com.au searches and property pages.
